roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and maintaining rigorous infection prevention standards, ensuring the highest quality of care for our residents.

In this position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for our clinical staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. You will also lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, policy implementation, and education to safeguard the health and well-being of everyone in our community. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about both education and public health within a supportive environment.

This full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join a team where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes and staff competency.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to staff training and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an Experienced Marketing Director to join a recently purchased skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact in a growing environment, contributing to the facility's success and community presence. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in driving census growth and enhancing the facility's reputation.

This role requires a proactive and results-driven individual who is comfortable with occasional weekend work to meet business demands. We are looking for a professional who is presentable and possesses a strong drive to achieve marketing objectives. Compensation is highly competitive for the right candidate, reflecting the importance of this leadership position.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting.
Professional demeanor and appearance, representing the facility with excellence.
Ability to work occasional weekends as required to meet business needs.
Demonstrated proactive and results-driven approach to marketing and community outreach.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with potential residents and families.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity offers flexibility while allowing you to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain mobility and improve their quality of life.As a Physical Therapist Assistant, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans. Your responsibilities will include assisting patients with therapeutic exercises, functional training, and other rehabilitation activities, ensuring a supportive and effective recovery environment.This PRN role is ideal for a skilled PTA looking for flexible scheduling options. Join a team committed to providing exceptional patient care and contributing to positive outcomes.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida.
Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is preferred.
Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative therapy team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) ranges from $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
